question: Who among the following became the first Indian female sailor to qualify for the Olympics when she qualified for the Tokyo 2020 Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nethra Kumanan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nethra Kumanan **became the** first Indian female sailor** to qualify for the Olympics in** April 2021.**
 
• She qualified for the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** in the **Laser Radial event.**
